title: Institutions — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: Educational and training institutions, used on employees' education and certification records.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: NameEn
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.rules: Required. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.

fields.label: University
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from University master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The university the institution belongs to, from the universities list.

Why it matters. Recorded for reference; nothing else uses it.

fields.label: Country
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Country master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The country the institution is in.

Example. United Kingdom

Why it matters. Recorded for reference; nothing else uses it.
